ops.title: Pack rediscovery must refresh the pack package __path__ (fixed in #353, 12.92.9)
ops.body:
`ensure_pack_package` (captain_hook/loader.py) used to return the cached `captain_hook._packs.<pack>` package untouched, so a worker that rediscovered a pack after a plugin update re-executed hook modules from the new release dir but resolved relative helper imports (skip-marked `.turns`, `.installed`, ...) through the first release's `__path__` and stale `sys.modules` entries. New helpers raised ModuleNotFoundError and their hooks dropped silently (long-running 0.7.46 -> 0.7.49 dropped six hooks; cc-skills #369 inlined a workaround).

Fix (#353, released v12.92.9): when the search path differs, set `__path__` to the new release dir and `evict_submodules(pkg)`. Regression test: tests/test_pack_imports.py::test_rediscovery_loads_helpers_from_the_newest_release.

Live cutover: the fix is in the Python package the signed host's workers run, so a running capt-hookd only gets it after the self-updater's `package-install` supersedes the host (next interactive SessionStart that may act), not live. The cc-skills #369 inline resolver can be dropped once hosts are on >= 12.92.9.
